# yosys, so under identical external inputs the two sides do NOT share a
# front-end binary.  This is declared BEFORE any run, not discovered after one.
# A resulting raw-source difference is still a REAL pipeline byte mismatch and
# is retained and attributed -- it is not excluded.  It does mean attribution
# will often land on the reader rather than on pass.lean, which is exactly why
# the identical-LG handoff of section 53.2 is worth running as a DIAGNOSTIC
# beside it: step 3 consumes $LG_NORM and never invokes yosys, so it isolates
# the emitter.  The handoff SUPPLEMENTS the same-external-input checks and
# cannot waive a mismatch found by them.
